instance.hotswap.description: Java hot reload for a running development instance with its debug port on: compiles the project (Gradle classes), compares the classes with what the game loaded and redefines changed method bodies over JDWP. Changes the JVM cannot apply (new or removed methods or fields, signature or hierarchy changes, static initializers, mixins, registration) are reported with restartRequired and nothing is applied. Long-running.

Records startup and world load times. The result is saved with the git commit so later runs can be compared. Needs the development bridge. Long-running.

The EULA is left for the server owner. Long-running.

path.description: Absolute path of the workspace (project folder)

server.deploy.description: Upload a server profile to a server over SFTP. Builds the server pack, compares it with what is on the server and, unless dryRun is true (the default), uploads new and changed files, removes mods that Modsmith uploaded earlier and that are no longer in the pack (when the target allows it), and records what it uploaded in .modsmith-deploy.json. server.properties, eula.txt and the world are never touched. A deploy that is not a dry run needs confirm: true. Needs a target from deploy.target_set and a trusted host key. Long-running.

deploy.host_key.description: Connect to an SFTP server without logging in and return its host key fingerprint, and whether Modsmith already trusts it.
